The video and audio engine used by Cja's Tools
==============================================

The files in this folder are not written by the Cja's Tools project. They are
FFmpeg, built to run inside a web browser by the ffmpeg.wasm project, and
included unchanged.

  ffmpeg.js, 814.ffmpeg.js
      @ffmpeg/ffmpeg 0.12.15 - MIT License
      https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm (packages/ffmpeg)

  ffmpeg-core.js, ffmpeg-core.wasm
      @ffmpeg/core 0.12.10 - GNU General Public License, version 2 or later
      FFmpeg (https://ffmpeg.org) built with --enable-gpl and these libraries:
      libx264, libx265, libmp3lame, libvpx, libopus, libvorbis, libtheora,
      libwebp, libass, freetype, fribidi, zimg, zlib.

Source code
-----------

The GPL gives everyone the right to the source code of these files. The
complete source, and the build scripts that turn it into these exact files,
are published by the ffmpeg.wasm project:

  https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/v0.12.10
  https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/releases/tag/v0.12.10

and the FFmpeg source itself at https://ffmpeg.org/download.html

The rest of Cja's Tools is MIT-licensed. The engine runs as a separate
program inside the app, started only by the video and audio tools.

GNU General Public License, version 2: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/gpl-2.0.html
